places-val-de-mamet-ii-hocino-de-chornas.story: 298 km from Caspe to Caspe, about 5 h 08 of riding. On the way it passes Els Secans, Abric del mas de Barberà, Los Estrechos I and Hocino de Chornas. The highest point is about 1,200 m. The line favours views over speed.
